terrain.method: Exact extrema at footprint/1 m terrain triangle intersections

buildings.policy: Unsurveyed 3m canopy retains its estimated height. Base uses the exact minimum of the source footprint intersected with final terrain triangles, preventing floating posts. This remains an explicit estimate, not a survey.
